DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Four Hundred or Two Thousand

STS-HS11-L4-6501000-HSELA1112-CMF-AAD-01 • HS English Grades 11 and 12 • Integrating and Evaluating Multiple Sources
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Mission File 9 has been sealed in this station's cabinet since 1963, and it holds five records of the same afternoon: a photograph, a map, a telegram, a reel of tape, and a city crowd count. The city wrote down four hundred people. The founder pointed his microphone out the window and let the street speak for four minutes, and Jabari has that tape in his hands. Nia has laid every source in a row on the floor because she says the order you read them in changes what you believe.
When five records of the same afternoon disagree, which one earns your trust, and what would it take to change your mind?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Imani doing?
Look at the picture. Say what Imani is doing, give your evidence with I know because, and say what she wants the team to notice.
2
What is Jabari holding?
Look at the picture. Say what Jabari is holding, give your evidence with I know because, and say why the team keeps it.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Say what the teacher is doing, give your evidence with I know because, and say how it helps the team.
4
What place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Name this place, give your evidence with I know because, and add a second clue from the room.
5
Tell me about the mission file board.
Look at the picture. Say what is on the board, give your evidence with I know because, and say which item you would trust.
6
Tell me about what Nia is wearing.
Look at the picture. Say what Nia is wearing, give your evidence with I know because, and say how it helps a listener find her.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: CCSS RI.11-12.7 — Integrate and Evaluate Multiple Sources of Information in Diverse Formats. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
